item.title: Allianz to remain as GAA sponsor
item.description: The GAA has decided to continue their sponsorship relationship with Allianz. Allianz have been long term sponsors of the national football and hurling leagues. A number of county boards including Roscommon and Leitrim moved proposals to central council to remove Allianz as a sponsor. However, the GAA’s Coiste Bainistíochta has decided to retain the Allianz sponsorship. item.title: Call to scrap Mercosur trade deal after vote delay
item.description: There's a call for the Mercosur trade deal to be scrapped. Independent Ireland TD Michael Fitzmaurice is making the demand, after the vote on the deal was postponed until January. Italy has asked for more time to address farmers' concerns, who protested in Brussels amid tension on Thursday. Advertisement Deputy Michael Fitzmaurice hopes no action was taken against farmers, as his party plans a protest in Athlone in the New Year.

item.title: Shop local appeal as Christmas countdown continues
item.description: People are being asked to shop local this weekend, as the countdown to Christmas continues. Towns throughout the Shannonside Northern Sound region will be busy with shoppers over the next two days. It's the last weekend before December 25th, which falls next Thursday. Advertisement Finola Armstrong-McGuire is the president of Carrick-on-Shannon Chamber.

item.title: Roscommon Council hopeful of Storm Éowyn cost recovery
item.description: The Chief Executive of Roscommon Council says he's hopeful the local authority will recoup costs from Storm Éowyn by the end of the year. Shane Tiernan says the council are owed over a million euro from the Government. Thousands of people in Roscommon, Leitrim and Longford were left without power for weeks following the devastating Storm in January. Advertisement Tiernan says the repayment process is ongoing.

item.title: Over 260 commencement notices issued across Shannonside region
item.description: Over 260 commencement notices have been issued in the Shannonside region so far this year. That's one of the findings from the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage, which has published its monthly figures. A Commencement Notice is a notification to a Building Control Authority that a person intends to carry out works or a Material Change of Use under the Building Regulations. Advertisement The notice must be given between 14 and 28 days before starting the works or change of use.

item.title: Western Alzheimers seeks musicians for Christmas fundraiser
item.description: A local charity is appealing to singers and music groups to take part in its Christmas fundraiser. The annual walk in aid of Western Alzheimers takes place in Roscommon on St Stephen's Day. Organisers, however, are looking for volunteers to provide musical entertainment after the walk. Advertisement Chairperson of Western Alzheimers Mairead Nally says everyone's invited to the event at Hannon's Hotel Mairead is asking musicians to give up some of their time on the day for a good cause. item.title: Wolves equal worst ever premier league start
item.description: Wolves equalled the lowest Christmas points tally in Premier League history after falling to a 10th straight defeat. Brentford scored a 2-0 win at Molineux, to leave Wolves with just two points from 17 games. “I just said it to the lads, we can’t give up!” explained boss Wolves Rob Edwards. ”That would be mental.
